name: financeos
description: FinanceOS – Personal Finance Management System (MERN Stack)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; const cmd = isWin ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm'; const s = spawn(cmd, ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: './server', stdio: 'inherit' }); const c = spawn(cmd, ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: './client', stdio: 'inherit' }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(); });"

author: Senior Full-Stack MERN Developer
